title: США проти ІРАНУ: Повне порівняння військового арсеналу
scope: Visual production using supplied unmodified script and voiceover; preserve episode 001

revision_rules.archive_captions: Only flags and source by default; short relevant thesis only when it adds information
revision_rules.information_cards: One entrance animation then hold still; never restart within a continuing card
revision_rules.archive_reuse: Same source or continuation separated by more than 60 seconds from previous use end
revision_rules.turntables: Real geometry only; full 360 degrees where a verified licensed model exists

storage_note: Separate temporary volume used to preserve all prior episode files. Delivery bundle must contain its own assets and relative paths.

checks.storyboard_review: source photos and video contacts; all six initial storyboard sheets; corrected assets reviewed separately
checks.pilot_review: encoded contact sheet inspected; not continuous human playback
